UP Police Book SP Leader for Offering Prayers on Circuit House Road

Uttar Pradesh Police have filed a First Information Report (FIR) against a Samajwadi Party (SP) leader for offering prayers on the road outside the Moradabad Circuit House. The incident occurred on the road adjacent to the circuit house. The FIR was registered under relevant sections of the Indian Penal Code. The SP leader's action has drawn criticism, with a Congress leader calling it a 'disgrace'.
